items.name: factory-floor-tyre-tracks
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated flat transparent floor decal for a hand-painted children's factory game. Strict orthographic TOP DOWN; image plane parallel to floor. Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor tile, no surrounding floor, no rectangular backdrop, no perspective, no words, no letters, no logos or UI. Clear simple shapes with modest wear, softly hand-painted surface. Keep every mark entirely inside image with transparent padding on ALL four edges. Two parallel muted dark charcoal rubber tire tracks left-to-right, with recognisable repeated broad diagonal tread bars and subtle gaps, slightly uneven and faded. A short 3:1 wide segment, both track bands end softly before the left and right image edge. Only the two worn print bands, no wheels, vehicle, mud blobs, dust cloud, footprint, arrows. Tracks separated by a transparent central lane.
